hooks.command:
printf '===== SESSION HANDOFF (HANDOFF.md) =====
Read this plus CLAUDE.md before starting work. Update HANDOFF.md before ending the session.

'; cat "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/HANDOFF.md" 2>/dev/null || echo '(HANDOFF.md not found)'

printf '
===== VOICE AND CRAFT CARD (AIOM_Prose_Standard_v2.0.md) =====
The one prose standard is AIOM_Prose_Standard_v2.0.md. Read it before drafting.
The voice is Concrete Management Prose: business reality first, claim first,
visible actors, ordinary business language, a coined term only after the
mechanism it names. The seven craft criteria (section 26) bind from Stage 0:

  C1 Concrete particular.  C2 Context and stakes.  C3 Claim first.
  C4 Deliberate rhythm.  C5 Paragraph close.
  C6 The guard holds in both directions: no hero or villain, no populist
     register, and no false sophistication.
  C7 Business reality first.

Process v4 (Decisions 75 to 81) governs Chapter 3 onward: see
AIOM_Process_v4_Proposal_v1.0.md and the chapter checklist.

'
